### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                    |
| ----- | ------ | -------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | love, respect, care        |
| ~a    | *psv.* | loved, beloved, cared for  |
| ~an   | *adj.* | loving, caring, respectful |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- a heart beating (notice that the heart is just [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Body parts/qan\|qan]] flipped on its side minus the blood vessels)
- Alternatively, imagine two hands; one is giving the heart and another is taking it. Love in the bible is defined as the giving of oneself to others.
#### Sound
- *a priori:* q=hidden power, u=deep
- A bit related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Concepts/qa\|qa]] (life; nodding to the philosophical notion of "love is what keeps life going")
